item.title: Rallying Cry – June 8, 2026
item.description: Spain’s World Cup squad gets a boost with Yamal and Williams back in action, while Armenia’s Pashinyan celebrates a fresh election win, India’s electric tuk-tuk revolution keeps rolling, and stargazers can catch Venus and Jupiter’s rare celestial dance.
